sentences.ar: الدكتور ليفزي إجا وقال له: بطل شرب.
sentences.en: Doctor Livesey came and told him: stop drinking.
The old man did not listen.
After days, a blind man came with a stick.
He put a paper in the old man’s hand and left.

sentences.ar: العجوز فتح الورقة وشاف نقطة سودا.
sentences.en: The old man opened the paper and saw a black spot.
He said: I have until tonight.
And a little later he fell and did not get up.
